description: FastAPI router module for handling CRUD operations and listing transactions in a finance tracking application.

classes.name: Transaction
classes.description: Data model representing a financial transaction, used for validation and database operations.

classes.name: TransactionCreate
classes.description: Schema for creating a new transaction.

classes.name: TransactionListFilters
classes.description: Schema for filtering transaction list queries.

methods.name: create_transaction
methods.description: Creates a new transaction for the current user.

methods.name: get_transaction
methods.description: Retrieves a transaction by ID if it belongs to the current user.

methods.name: update_transaction
methods.description: Updates an existing transaction if it belongs to the current user.

methods.name: delete_transaction
methods.description: Deletes a transaction if it belongs to the current user.

methods.name: list_transactions
methods.description: Lists transactions with optional filters and pagination.
